notes.title: Main Menu Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]The Main Menu Update![/h1]

The Main Menu update is finally here! Not only does this bring a plethora of new content, but also, it ports the previously beta-exclusive Save System update out of beta.

This update focuses on reworking the Main Menu. A fresh new coat of paint! I've added a new Main Menu Theme along with 4 variations every time you start the game. Also a new way of getting around the Main Menu, which is just a longer way of saying, more buttons! Additionally, a new Cosmetics menu where you can find all your favorite skins for Over & Under, and new ones, only available to those with [i]special promo codes[/i]. Here's one now, a little gift for taking the time to read this message. Type 'redlvl' into the promo code function to unlock the skin for the first boss.

New content:
[list]
[*] Revamped main menu transportation.
[*] Automatic Cloud Saves so you can just pause the game and use the 'exit' button, and it'll instantly save your progress, so you can later smoothly roll back into the game.
[*] A fresh look for the skin selector.
[*] Six new exclusive skins only available via promo code (more on this below).
[*] And some patches here and there, of course.
[/list]
So, where can you find these promo codes? Well, you can find one right here in this update log, and another one will be hidden somewhere in either a later log or a previous log.
For the rest, please head over to Discord, where you can find a community of people who play Over & Under. Here it is: [url=https://discord.gg/eC8HTrqMHe]Over & Under on Discord[/url].
One you're in Discord, you can find one of the promo codes somewhere in the server's channels (I'll pin it, so look out for a pinned message).
Lastly, three of the codes are special because they are only to be given away be 3 special people. Check their bios/messages and look for a code! In the server, they have the 'promo code' role.

Thanks for checking out this message and happy playing!

notes.title: Update Notes for July 24! (I add an exclamation mark when stuff is exciting!)
notes.notes:
BIG OPTMIZATION UPDATE!

Finished prefabbing and integrating addressables to the later levels, meaning they will now load in and out fairly smoothly around their respective transition checkpoints. This should greatly lighten the load on your computer.

This is not just an optimization update. This update marks a milestone--- the end of major bug fixing for the levels and bosses! What does this mean? In the coming updates, you'll get actually NEW content! Isn't that nice? Expect modes, achievements, and possibly new levels!

In addition to the optimization stuff, two new skins have been added, some UI has been re-centered, and I threw in a few new tips. For your sake, and in turn my sake, please take a few moments of your time to check out the tips. They offer a lot of good advice!

notes.title: Update Notes for July 21
notes.notes:
Small Bug Fix Update!

Fixed some trouble with the UI, with focus on the minimap. Added a box to show the player's location in the minimap.
Also fixed a bug where the new boss always had a maximum health of half it's actual maximum.

notes.notes: Just a quick fix, I centered the tip feature wrong!

notes.title: Update Notes for July 12
notes.notes:
[h1]Update: Tips and Tricks![/h1]

New additions! A 'tips' spot with alternating tips can now be found on the menu screen. Additionally, some smaller fixes like lowering the save data font size so it doesn't cross over the other UI.
Also, a pause button has been added, to make the pause menu more intuitive. Another implementation is a small WASD compass icon that appears upon hitting play. It won't disappear until the player has used all four of the default movement keys.

notes.title: Update Notes for July 11
notes.notes:
[h1]Bugs and balance tweaks![/h1]

A few more bugs have successfully been squashed! I'm afraid this won't be the last patch though, so I'll stay vigilant.
Additionally, a few balance tweaks have been made to make certain playthroughs possible/easier. Amongst this, the last 18 levels have been adapted to make certain modes much more playable and function how they're supposed to.
In the coming updates, I will make balance tweaks to the new levels, as well as generally finalizing the level's design before moving on to more exciting, new content.

notes.title: Update Notes for Jul 10
notes.notes:
[h1]First release patch![/h1]

Just a simple release patch to resolve an issue and such.

[list]
[*] Added a tip inform the player about the pause function.
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn't open the pause menu after beating any boss.
[*] Added a key, escape, that always pauses regardless of your pause keybinds.
[/list]
